title: 2BR Guest House - 15 min walk to 5 Points
description:
Detached guest house on a quiet East Nashville street; your own building, private entrance, and driveway parking.

Two bedrooms, each with a queen bed. Full kitchen and a full bath.

Five Points is 0.8 miles away: about a 15-minute walk, or 3 minutes by car. Nissan Stadium is a 7-minute drive and Broadway is under 10. A bus stop is a block and a half from the door.

Kroger, Aldi, and Publix are all within three blocks if you'd rather cook than go out.

Permit #2022081128

The space
Our guest house is a garage apartment behind the main house, up a flight of stairs from the driveway. The whole second floor is yours — private entrance, no shared walls with us.

Inside: two bedrooms with queens, a full bath, living area, and a kitchen, all on one level.

The kitchen is apartment-sized but fully equipped — fridge, stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, Keurig, and electric kettle. Everything you need to cook a real meal.

Guest access
The entire apartment is yours — private entrance, your own key, and no shared interior space with us.

You have a dedicated parking spot in the driveway. 

The backyard is shared with our family. You're welcome to use it any time, and we're happy to give you space.

We live in the main house and are around if you need anything, but we won't be in your space unless you ask.

Other things to note
This apartment is on the second floor - stairs are necessary to enter the unit.
